This workflow is only here for tutorial type purposes.  SDXL with refiner is very much outdated.  However, for historic and tutorial purposes I point people to this tutorial because it was one of the first and best tutorials I've seen on how to use sdxl online.  There is a lot of other stuff out there but this is one of the most basic to learn from in how the comfy ui actually works.  It's also the ONLY place online I've read about ascore.  I have no idea if ascoare is really necessary in anything except sdxl but as it's a form of data I suspect it may have some sort o fhidden arcane use no one has knowledge of in this sd 3.5+ world we now life in.
